LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 3.1.2 SELF EXPRESSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Observing and Articulating signs 3.1.2 Self expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 3.1.2 Self expression under Strand 3. It is aligned with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) CBC design.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 3.1.2 Self expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: communication and self expression as learner uses vocabulary to express their needs and

ideas in and out of school.

● Self-efficacy: as learner expresses self in discussions and answering questions.

Values:
● Respect: Patience as learner takes turn in telling news and stories.

● Unity: Cooperation as learner work together with others in harmony to perform assigned roles.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner work amicably with others in telling news and stories.

Link to other Activity Areas:

● Creative Activities (Music) as learner sign sings songs related to expressing needs and ideas.

● Learner relates expressing needs with praying in Religious Education Activity.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, puzzles, jigsaw, signed stories and songs, online resources, relevant digital devices.
